dog.description_text:
Meet Sucrose, an affectionate lady looking for a loving home!

One of our favorite things about Sucrose is how much she loves to snuggle with her people. In her foster home she is noted to follow them around and continually request cuddles and endless pets by rubbing her face all over you! She also has an adorable chirp she uses when rolling around and showing her belly to ask for more love!

For playtime, she loves her cat nip banana and will get the occasional zoomies when it suits her. Outside of these hobbies, Sucrose’s favorite thing in the world is lounging around and taking the world in. She will ensure to take her time exploring her space and finding the perfect perch to jump up and relax on. If there is a window nearby, she loves watching the birds, trees and other sights and sounds of the city!

Are you ready to meet the next love of your life? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about Sucrose!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
